name: security-checks
title: 보안 검사 — 비밀값·의존성·SAST
use: Security scanners on a target repo (gitleaks, npm audit, osv-scanner, semgrep, bandit) for the Architecture map.
rules: The target repo path is given in the request text. Do not edit, commit, checkout or install anything in the target repo; do not install tools. The runner writes only under ${MAILBOX_DIR:-~/.mailbox-mcp}/arch/<key>/<HEAD>/checks-security.json (same store key as arch-map). Metadata only: never copy tool messages, secret values, matched text or source lines into a report.

stages.title: 보안 검사
stages.task: Run `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/arch_checks.py --repo <repo> --category security` once from this repository (it detects the scanners, runs each with a timeout and writes checks-security.json). Add `--net` only when the request asks for advisory lookups (npm audit, osv-scanner need the network; without it they are skipped). Report its printed line only. Do not rerun with other options, do not run any tool yourself, do not fix findings.
